title: Gulfstream Fishing, Inc.
specs: Fishing 3 to 10 miles offshore in 20 to 100+ feet of water
Common catches: snapper, grouper, jacks, mackerel, grunts, cobia, amberjack
Night fishing includes sunset cruise and active feeding fish
All ages welcome; children 12 and under $42.95, infants under 5 $39.95 on party boat
No fishing experience or license needed for party boat trips
Private charters CPR/First Aid trained crew
Party boat up to 40 anglers per trip
Private charters suitable for bachelor parties, corporate events, birthdays, family reunions

blurb: Guests fish from the Gulfstream IV party boat or book private charters. Trips include all gear, bait, and Florida saltwater fishing licenses. The party boat is shared with up to 40 anglers; private charters are exclusive to your group.
extraNote: Rod rental available for $5 · Bring your own food and drinks; alcohol permitted on private charters · Catering available on private charters on request · Arrive 30 minutes before departure for check-in · Docked at Historic Charter Boat Row in Key West, Florida
